name: Netlify
description: Web hosting / deployment platform with an OpenAPI-documented REST API for sites, deploys, forms, DNS, env vars and hooks.
access_notes: Free self-serve accounts; PATs generated instantly in User settings > Applications > Personal access tokens and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer <PAT>'. Public integrations 'must use OAuth2' - register an OAuth app self-serve at app.netlify.com/applications (authorize endpoint https://app.netlify.com/authorize).
mcp_notes: Official vendor MCP server @netlify/mcp (github.com/netlify/netlify-mcp, documented at docs.netlify.com 'Netlify MCP Server'); local npx server using CLI auth or NETLIFY_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN. No Netlify toolkit found in the docs.composio.dev/toolkits catalog.
uncertainty_notes: Webhooks: Netlify's OpenAPI reference includes hooks/deploy-notification endpoints and outgoing webhook notifications; specific webhook docs page not fetched this pass. Composio absence based on grep of the current docs.composio.dev/toolkits catalog page.

evidence.note: 'Netlify uses OAuth2 for authentication'; PAT self-serve in user settings, used as Authorization: Bearer; public integrations must use OAuth2 with app registered at app.netlify.com/applications.
Official OpenAPI reference: 'REST-style API that uses JSON... OAuth 2 for authentication' covering deploys, sites, forms, snippets, hooks and more.
Official Netlify MCP Server enabling agents to use the Netlify API/CLI; auth via CLI login or NETLIFY_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN env var.
Vendor docs page for the Netlify MCP Server (linked as canonical docs from the official repo).
